caption: The drawing depicts a single large metallic container with a cylindrical shape, slightly wider at the base and narrowing toward the top. The container is mostly brown with areas of rust, displaying shades of red, brown, and dark gray, giving a textured and weathered appearance. It has two circular horizontal ridges and small protruding handles on either side near the upper part. On top of the container sits a small, glazed clay or ceramic cup, which is a glossy reddish-orange color with highlights and shadows indicating its rounded form. The background is plain, in a light beige or off-white shade, without any additional objects or details. There is a handwritten signature "Owen Fortuny" in the lower left area of the image.
title: Churn
